contexts.text: He who passes into the other life loses nothing of the things which belong to a man.
No passing to one's fathers by death is here signified.
I will pass through all thy flock today () = to know and perceive the quality of the good.
If I shall not pass this heap to thee, and if thou shalt not pass this heap and this statue to me, for evil () = the limit of how much can inflow from good. To pass, here, = to inflow.
In my staff I passed over this Jordan () = ... initiation...
To dwell in the passage of Jordan () = in those things which are initiaments; thus which are the primes and ultimates of the Lord's Kingdom.
He made them pass over the river, and made what he had pass over () = further insinuation. Explained.
Let my lord pass over before his servant () = more general presence. Explained.
When man passes from the natural world into the Spiritual. LJ 9:8.
By transit through the Heavens, He (then) presented Himself as a Divine Man...
The days of his bemoaning passed away () = that the states of sorrow were accomplished.
With such, the passage for the light of Heaven is closed.
The Divine becomes human when it passes through the Heavens; and, when it has passed through the Heavens, it is presented in a human form, and becomes speech...
The Divine truth proceeding from the Lord... must pass to man by mediations...
The Divine truth... is not perceivable in Heaven, except in proportion as it passes through Heaven...

The Divine truth which proceeds mediately from the Lord is adapted to the Angels in the Heavens, and also to men; for it passes through Heaven, and so puts on an angelic quality, and a human quality...
In the same proportion the interiors, through which the passage is, are closed.
In order that this Scientific may become of faith, it must be conjoined with good; and it then passes into the internal man...
Jehovah will pass through () = the presence of the Divine.
When they passed through the Hells...
The transmission through the midst of damnation, is signified by the passing through the Sea Suph.
Until Thy people shall pass through () = that all (such) will be saved without danger of infestation. Explained.
For, so long as the evil hail not been cast into Hell, scarcely any could pass through; that is, be saved.
Pass through before the people () = that he shall lead and teach them. Explained.
The communication of the interiors with the exteriors is effected marvellously by means of transits as it were fibrous.
The transits from one to the other in successive order are also called degrees.
That which inflows from the Divine passes through Heaven, and, there, is celestial and spiritual; but when it comes into the world, it becomes mundane, containing the former within it.
The Divine truth... passes through the Heavens down to man; and, on the way, is accommodated to each Heaven...
Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over () = the ultimate of Divine truth in which interior things cease...
No one in one Heaven can possibly pass into another.
The tables were written from the two transits; from hence and from hence were they written () = by which there is conjunction of the Lord with the human race, or of Heaven with the world. Explained.

Pass ye through and return from gate to gate in the camp () = wherever there is anything open from the internal into the external; (for) to pass through and return = to survey and look around from one end to the other.
To make to pass () = upon it.
When He passed through Heaven, He clothed Himself in the form of an Angel.
Death is only the passage. LJCont 32:end.
Everyone expects the passing away and destruction of heaven and earth.
Whatever is in excess passes off.
The Lord's life passes through Heaven...
When he touched me with his hand and arms, he passed through my [body]; but afterwards he did not pass through...
Man would have passed from his earthly body, without disease.

That evils and falsities will then break in on every side, is signified by: I will bring their destruction from all the passages thereof (); for, in the Spiritual World, where the evil are, there lie open on all sides ways from the Hells; and, through these, evils and the derivative falsities break in; and through the same ways go all who are in the like evils and falsities...
To pass through, in the Word, is said of truths; and to dwell, of goods.
Gilead, why dwellest thou in the passage of Jordan? () = livest thou solely in externals, which are of the natural man?
How intelligence increases by the reception of Divine truth... is described by the waters which he passed through ().
A passage () = opening and free reception.
The Divine truth has passed through the Heavens in (their) order...
Holy Spirit. 4. The Divine called the Holy Spirit... passes through the angelic Heaven... iii, General article.
